rules.sector_statistic: minimum of valid returns; require a valid return in every column
rules.clearance_boundary: range must be strictly greater than envelope
rules.speed_selection: largest tier whose envelope is strictly below centre minimum; otherwise zero

questions.name: path_blocked
questions.meaning: Centre-sector return at or inside the current-speed draft envelope.

questions.name: clear_sector
questions.meaning: Clearest qualifying observed sector, not a collision-free steering command.

questions.name: speed_tier
questions.meaning: Observed straight-line ceiling at 0, 1/3, 2/3 or full Config.max_speed.

questions.name: mode
questions.meaning: No deterministic policy-mode label is supplied by this draft.

limitations: Not approved for training datasets, live teacher labeling, training or deployment.
No world geometry, expert action, future observation or collision truth is used.
Planar rays, limited field of view, noise and radial minima do not prove a free swept footprint.
No turning dynamics, noise-bound guarantee, physical thresholds or host fail-safe policy is established.
